Title: Tropical Hawaiian Chicken on Rice
Instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a sheet pan/baking tray.
Cook rice according to packet instructions so it’s ready to serve when the chicken is done.
In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1/4 tsp chilli flakes (optional), plus salt and black pepper to taste.
Place the chicken breasts on the tray. Drizzle over the marinade and turn the chicken to coat evenly.
Add 1 cup pineapple chunks, the sliced red bell pepper, and the sliced 1/2 red onion around the chicken on the tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, then check the chicken. Continue roasting up to 30 minutes total, until the chicken reaches 75°C internal temperature and the veg is tender.
Rest the chicken for 3–5 minutes, then slice.
Serve the chicken and roasted pineapple/veg over the cooked rice and garnish with chopped coriander/cilantro if using.
Customizations: Add more heat: increase the chilli flakes or add a dash of hot sauce to the marinade.
Add freshness: squeeze over a little lime juice before serving.
Add crunch: sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds or chopped cashews.
OptionalInstructions: If the chicken breasts are very thick, pound them to an even thickness so they cook evenly.
If using canned pineapple, drain it well so the tray doesn’t get too watery.
ServingSuggestions: Serve over steamed jasmine rice or basmati rice.
Add a side of cucumber salad for something fresh and crunchy.
